title: PasswordReset does not work for Accu-Check Spirit Combo
symptom: After creating a PasswordReset empty file in AAPS/extra folder and restarting the app, the file disappears and a message says the password was set, but the master password is not the Combo serial number, so login fails.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. A comment suggests that with the V1 Combo driver and Ruffy, the pump serial number was the Mac Address, implying the password might be the MAC address instead of the serial number.
fix: The thread does not provide a confirmed fix. A maintainer advises upgrading to AAPS 3.1, but the user reports the issue persists after upgrading. Another comment hints that the password might be the MAC address when using the V1 driver with Ruffy.
evidence_quote: With V1 and Ruffy the pump serial number was the Mac Address.
